ideas.name: Overnight Return Component Sorting
ideas.claim: A portfolio sorted on the prior month's overnight stock returns showed continuation overnight and reversal intraday in the following month.
ideas.quote: In each sort, we then go long the value-weight winner decile and short the value-weight loser decile.

rules.timeframe: Monthly portfolio sort; overnight and intraday return components
rules.entry: At each month-end, sort stocks into deciles by the prior month's overnight returns; go long the value-weighted winner decile and short the value-weighted loser decile.
rules.exit: Reform the portfolio at the next month-end.
rules.filters: Exclude stocks priced below $5 and stocks in the bottom NYSE size quintile.

ideas.claimed_result: The overnight-sorted hedge portfolio earned an average overnight excess return of 3.47% per month and an average intraday excess return of -3.24% per month.
required_data: Daily stock open and close prices
